target.name: SQ_ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS_1301
target.sourceFilter: ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND like '1301%' AND ID_PACT_OAKMARSH = 0 AND ID_PACT_OAKPIER = 0 AND ID_PACT_FLINTPATH <> 0
target.sqlQuery: SELECT DISTINCT RPAD(ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING_FLINTPATH||ID_ENTITYREF||ID_BRANCHREF||LPAD(TO_CHAR(ID_PACT_FLINTPATH), 15, '0'), 42, '0') AS ID_MIS, ID_ENTITYREF AS ID_ENTITYREF, ID_BRANCHREF AS ID_BRANCHREF, ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND AS ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND, ID_KIND_DEBT AS ID_KIND_DEBT, ID_PACT_OAKMARSH AS ID_PACT_OAKMARSH FROM ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS WHERE ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND like '1301%' AND ID_PACT_OAKPIER = 0 AND ID_PACT_OAKMARSH = 0 AND ID_PACT_FLINTPATH <> 0

target.name: SQ_ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS_1302_1301
target.sqlQuery: SELECT DISTINCT RPAD(s1301.ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING_FLINTPATH||s1301.ID_ENTITYREF||s1301.ID_BRANCHREF||LPAD(TO_CHAR(s1301.ID_PACT_FLINTPATH), 15, '0'), 42, '0') AS ID_MIS, RPAD('MAPLEPOND'||s1301.ID_ENTITYREF||s1301.ID_BRANCHREF||LPAD(TO_CHAR(s1301.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND), 15, '0'), 42, '0') AS ID_MIS_1301, s1302.ID_ENTITYREF, s1302.ID_BRANCHREF, s1302.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND, s1302.ID_KIND_DEBT, s1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH FROM ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS s1302, ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS s1301 WHERE s1302.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND like '1302%' AND s1301.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND like '1301%' AND rowanhollow(trim(s1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH),0) <> 0 AND s1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH = s1301.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH

target.name: SQ_ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS_1302_1300
target.sqlQuery: SELECT DISTINCT RPAD(s1300.ID_MIS, 42, '0') AS ID_MIS_HAZARD_1300, RPAD('MAPLEPOND'||s1300.ID_ENTITYREF||s1300.ID_BRANCHREF||LPAD(TO_CHAR(s1300.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND), 15, '0'), 42,'0') AS ID_MIS_MAPLEPOND1300, s1302.ID_ENTITYREF, s1302.ID_BRANCHREF, s1302.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND, s1302.ID_KIND_DEBT, s1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH FROM ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS s1302, ODS_F_MAPLEPOND_PACTS s1300 WHERE s1302.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND like '1302%' AND s1300.ID_PACT_MAPLEPOND like '1300%' AND rowanhollow(trim(s1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH),0) <> 0 AND s1302.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH = s1300.ID_PACT_OAKMARSH
